versions.changelog:
novel-assistant v1.0.3

- Enhanced documentation: SKILL.md now features detailed usage scenarios, workflow guides, and examples for all core functions.
- Expanded description of capabilities, including chapter creation, character/world management, timeline/foreshadowing tracking, memory file compression, backups, multi-project support, and character dialogue style library.
- Added trigger keywords and applicable use cases for easier discovery and application.
- Provides structured best practices for long-form and collaborative novel writing.
